description: Package/environment delivery flow. Release means CD approval and retention, not a proven production deployment. Merge-to-retention is not commit-to-production DORA lead time. Approval-stage non-release is not production change failure rate. Production deployment and incident/recovery events are required for production DORA metrics.

panels.title: Summary (merged PRs and CD runs in the selected range)

panels.description: Median time from PR merge to the end of the first CD run that contained it and passed its approval stages (released clean or with failures). Per PR and environment.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOChangeLeadTimeTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Environment:singlequote}) or Environment in (${Environment:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds} and IsReleased eq 1)/groupby((PullRequestId,Environment,MergeToRelease))&$top=20000

panels.title: Merge → release (median)

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOChangeLeadTimeTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Environment:singlequote}) or Environment in (${Environment:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds})/groupby((PullRequestId,Environment,MergeToFirstCD))&$top=20000

panels.title: Merge → first CD run (median)

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOPipelineRunsTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Environment:singlequote}) or Environment in (${Environment:singlequote})) and Role eq 'CD' and StartedAt ge ${__from:date:iso} and StartedAt lt ${__to:date:iso} and (ReleaseOutcome eq 'ReleasedClean' or ReleaseOutcome eq 'ReleasedWithFailures'))/groupby((Organization),aggregate(BuildId with countdistinct as Releases))&$top=20000

panels.title: Releases

panels.description: CD attempts classified NotReleased divided by CD attempts with a recorded release outcome. This is a pre-release approval/retention measure, not DORA change failure rate. Production deployment failures requiring intervention and recovery events are not collected here.

ADOTelemetry.ADOPipelineRunsTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Environment:singlequote}) or Environment in (${Environment:singlequote})) and Role eq 'CD' and StartedAt ge ${__from:date:iso} and StartedAt lt ${__to:date:iso} and ReleaseOutcome ne null)/groupby((Organization),aggregate(BuildId with countdistinct as WithOutcome))&$top=20000

panels.title: Approval-stage non-release rate

panels.description: For each CD environment: median wait from merge to the first CD run that contained the PR (teal) and from that run to release (blue). A long blue segment = PRs ride several failed CD attempts before one is released. Common environment prefixes are omitted from axis labels. Segment values are in tooltips; full environment names remain in the data.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOChangeLeadTimeTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Environment:singlequote}) or Environment in (${Environment:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds})/groupby((PullRequestId,Environment,MergeToFirstCD,MergeToRelease))&$top=20000

panels.title: Lead time per environment (median)

panels.description: PRs grouped by the Monday-based week they merged in: median merge → release (blue) and merge → first CD (teal) per PR × environment, plus how many PR × environment pairs are still not released (grey bars, right axis). Recent weeks always look faster: their slow PRs are not released yet, so read the line together with the grey bars.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOChangeLeadTimeTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Environment:singlequote}) or Environment in (${Environment:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds})/groupby((PullRequestId,Environment,Merged,MergeToFirstCD,MergeToRelease,IsReleased))&$top=20000

panels.title: Release lead time per week of merge

panels.description: Each CD run, by start time, per environment, colored until the next run: green = released clean, orange = released with test failures, red = not released at the approval stage, grey = never reached an approval stage (failed earlier or cancelled). targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOPipelineRunsTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Environment:singlequote}) or Environment in (${Environment:singlequote})) and Role eq 'CD' and Environment ne null and StartedAt ge ${__from:date:iso} and StartedAt lt ${__to:date:iso})/groupby((BuildId,Environment,StartedAt,ReleaseOutcome,Result))&$top=20000

panels.title: CD outcome timeline per environment
Which PRs started a test-failure streak?

panels.description: Data set ADOTestFailureSuspects: for each test failing in the range, the CD build where its failure streak started, and the PRs that were new in that build (in its change list but not in the previous run of the same pipeline and environment). Title, repository and merge date come from ADOPullRequests and are blank for PRs that data set does not hold. Candidates, not proven causes: when a build brings many new PRs (e.g. 36701) the list is long and the signal is weak.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOTestFailureSuspectsTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Environment:singlequote}) or Environment in (${Environment:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and LastFailed ge ${__from:date:seconds} and LastFailed lt ${__to:date:seconds})/groupby((Organization,Project,PullRequestId,Team,Environment,FailingSinceBuildId),aggregate(Test with countdistinct as Tests,LastFailed with max as LastFailed))&$top=20000

panels.title: PRs new in the build where tests started failing

panels.description: Per test in the range: how many separate failure streaks it had (Streaks; a streak restarts after the test passes), builds it failed in, and its longest streak in days. targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOTestFailuresTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Suite:singlequote}) or TestRun in (${Suite:singlequote})) and FailedAt ge ${__from:date:iso} and FailedAt lt ${__to:date:iso})/groupby((Test,Pipeline,TestRun),aggregate(FailingSinceBuildId with countdistinct as Streaks,BuildId with countdistinct as FailedBuilds,FailingDays with max as LongestStreak,FailedAt with max as LastFailed))&$orderby=FailedBuilds desc&$top=300

panels.description: A deployment = a CD run that got through install, master data and tests and reached the approval stage (released, released with failures, or timed out waiting). Deployment frequency. Lines: use the Environment filter at the top, one environment is one line (each environment is fed by one release line, development or release/x.y). Merge and release times are per environment, so compare a line only with itself.
